title: Tiny, cute snowman
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='40%' cy='30%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#dceefb'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a9cfe8'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='headGrad' cx='40%' cy='30%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#e2f1fc'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b6d8ee'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='30' ry='6' fill='#5a7f9e'/>

  <!-- bottom body ball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='74' r='20' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <!-- middle body ball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='15' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>

  <!-- stick arms -->
  <path d='M33 48 L18 38 M18 38 L13 43 M18 38 L16 31' stroke='#8b5a2b' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M67 48 L82 38 M82 38 L87 43 M82 38 L84 31' stroke='#8b5a2b' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d='M36 40 Q50 46 64 40 L64 45 Q50 51 36 45 Z' fill='#e8453c'/>
  <path d='M60 43 L63 56 L56 57 L55 44 Z' fill='#c93028'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='14' fill='url(#headGrad)'/>

  <!-- hat brim -->
  <rect x='33' y='15' width='34' height='5' rx='2' fill='#3a2f6b'/>
  <!-- hat top -->
  <rect x='38' y='3' width='24' height='13' rx='3' fill='#4b3f88'/>
  <rect x='38' y='11' width='24' height='5' fill='#e8453c'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='26' r='2.2' fill='#2a2350'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='26' r='2.2' fill='#2a2350'/>

  <!-- carrot nose -->
  <path d='M50 31 L60 34 L50 36 Z' fill='#f28c28'/>

  <!-- smile: coal dots -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='35' r='1.4' fill='#2a2350'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='37.5' r='1.4' fill='#2a2350'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='37.5' r='1.4' fill='#2a2350'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='35' r='1.4' fill='#2a2350'/>

  <!-- buttons -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='49' r='2' fill='#2a2350'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='2' fill='#2a2350'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='63' r='2' fill='#2a2350'/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='32' r='2.5' fill='#f7a8b8' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='32' r='2.5' fill='#f7a8b8' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
